name: Комната Персика
prompt: A small playful bedroom belonging to Peach, a tiny round peach-shaped creature. Pastel peach, soft pink, light yellow and gentle green accents. A small bed, messy creative desk, colored pencils, sketchbooks, paper sheets, toy boxes, drawings on the walls and a small shelf with sweets. One especially big drawing on the wall that Peach calls his masterpiece. The room feels energetic, creative and slightly messy. Hand-drawn children's storybook illustration, warm paper texture, imperfect black outlines, colored pencil strokes. Preserve the exact room layout and furniture.
